# 1 Clement Chapter 64 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 64 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_064_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 64

*[Closing Doxology]*

**64:1** Now may the God of all, who sees all things, and who is the Master of all spirits and the Lord of all flesh, who chose the Lord Jesus Christ, and us through him to be a peculiar people — may he grant to every soul that is called by his magnificent and holy name: faith, fear, peace, longsuffering, self-control, purity, and sobriety, that so they may be well-pleasing to his name, through our High Priest and Guardian Jesus Christ, through whom to him be glory and majesty, might and honor, both now and for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness.*
